scope.inventory: Every existing tracked or nonignored untracked project file, including retained tests/demos, hidden project configuration and support code.
excluded: ignored logs, exports, .artifacts and .tools caches/downloaded third-party addons
scope.generated_map_hash: The map inventories itself without hashing its own content.
scope.purpose_policy: Initial implementation-derived descriptions are explicit in purpose_origin. Reviewed prose is retained. After any function change, --update marks its purpose for review; --check fails until --purpose records a current explanation.
scope.graph_limits: Static calls only. Unproven receivers reference call_candidates, not proven runtime edges. Unmatched calls are retained compactly in external_or_dynamic_calls, which can include unresolved runtime targets. Signal/deferred connections are retained. Assignments include locals, not a complete side-effect analysis. Literal resource reachability is conservative (including resource-like strings/comments), not proof of execution. No execution/test coverage is implied.

functions.purpose: Resolve one current player-visible friendly person and center observation on its finite position; select and redraw without creating a tactical order or changing physical state. Reject missing, enemy or non-person identities.
